$comment: Generic AI/template looks the engine refuses by default. Enforced in validation (spec level, src/design/banned.ts) and in QC (pixel level, src/qc/pattern-detect.ts). A pattern is only allowed when the user asked for it or a supplied reference clearly needs it: set video.json design.allowPatterns / design.justification.

patterns.why: Repeated small dots read as a generic template texture and compete with Arabic i'jam dots.
Random point fields are decoration without a job.
Blueprint grids are the default 'tech' cliché.
Busy repeating stripes fight the text.
Floating rings/plus marks/bursts scattered in corners have no purpose.
Glow on every element flattens hierarchy.
Neon glow only when the brand or request is neon.
Glass on every card is a cliché and an expensive backdrop blur.
One atmospheric light per film, not a blob per heading.
One entrance for everything reads mechanical.
Fade alone does not explain hierarchy or cause/effect.
The same card layout repeated scene after scene.
Heading → cards → CTA for every video regardless of story.
Blue-violet gradient used without brand or request.
HUD overlays only when asked for.
A label on every scene is noise.
Grain above ~0.15 over text costs legibility and bitrate.
